objective: Freeze reference-economy classes and extraction rules before computing any empirical calibration bands.

referenceEconomyClasses.label: advanced diversified market economies
referenceEconomyClasses.purpose: broad baseline for labour share, household saving/consumption and firm-finance ratios
referenceEconomyClasses.candidateMembershipRule: high-income OECD members with diversified sector structure and sufficiently complete official series

referenceEconomyClasses.label: advanced manufacturing-intensive economies
referenceEconomyClasses.purpose: sector productivity and materials/capital-goods relative-value comparison
referenceEconomyClasses.candidateMembershipRule: high-income OECD members with above-median manufacturing value-added share and sufficient STAN/SUT coverage

referenceEconomyClasses.label: resource-exposed advanced economies
referenceEconomyClasses.purpose: RESOURCE-sector sensitivity and relative-value comparison without treating mining/agriculture as universal
referenceEconomyClasses.candidateMembershipRule: high-income economies with material resource-sector contribution and sufficient official industry data

referenceEconomyClasses.label: high household-saving advanced economies
referenceEconomyClasses.purpose: upper behavioural/accounting reference for realized household saving, not desiredConsumptionBudget
referenceEconomyClasses.candidateMembershipRule: advanced economies persistently above the median household saving rate over the selected window

extractionFamilies.targetStatistic: multi-year country distribution and robust class band
extractionFamilies.timeWindowCandidate: 2019-2024 or latest six complete annual observations

extractionFamilies.concept: household saving rate and realized consumption share of disposable income
extractionFamilies.preferredSourceFamily: OECD national accounts / Eurostat sector accounts
extractionFamilies.targetStatistic: multi-year country distribution, median and central band
extractionFamilies.timeWindowCandidate: 2019-2025 subject to complete comparable annual data

extractionFamilies.concept: sector-relative value added, labour input and compensation
extractionFamilies.preferredSourceFamily: OECD STAN after OECD SUT use-classification bridge
extractionFamilies.targetStatistic: within-country sector-relative ratios followed by cross-country robust bands
extractionFamilies.classification: ISIC Rev.4 plus documented intermediate/investment/final-use allocation

extractionFamilies.preferredSourceFamily: official central-bank, statistical-office or OECD SME/business-finance evidence
extractionFamilies.targetStatistic: size-class-specific cash/expense coverage and AR/AP/inventory timing distributions

nextFront: R4-CU-D3B freeze class membership and execute first official multi-country extraction
